resumen:
Persuasion marketing applies human psychology to promotions and builds on impulsive behaviour (A).
Salespeople use it and now translate it to the web; it helps e-commerce convert visits to sales (A).
Customers are more sensitive in a 'persuasion window'; e.g. offers on 'thank you' pages convert at 39% (A).
Elements: structured communication, storytelling, copywriting and neuromarketing (A).
Persuasion advertising uses negative, humor, sex, fear and comparative appeals (B.1).
